Crop of one slip from a Players Committee Virtual card sheet, showing the label above the slip and the margin note beside the slip number, for [[Uncharted Settlements (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier) (Original)|Uncharted Settlements (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)]]: the margin note prints "•Path Of Least Resistance & Revealed (V)" with one dot; the Decipher card [[Path Of Least Resistance & •Revealed]] marks both halves.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards15.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards15.pdf], Virtual Set 15 Remaster sheet ("official text as of March 21, 2008"), page 2, slip 33. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008193554/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards15.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]

Edits: the slip area was rendered from the PDF at 216 dpi and cropped; nothing else changed. Used on [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History#Slip labels and margin notes]].
